subject: Mutual Action Plan draft — owners, target close date, and procurement runway
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@blueport.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:24:00 -0000
Subject: Mutual Action Plan draft — owners, target close date, and procurement runway

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an aligned MAP draft to share with procurement/legal.

Call highlights (short):
- Goals: production inference for first integration (search assistant) by end of August; initial 3-week pilot + SLA review.
- Constraints: Blueport procurement needs PO + signed SOW; finance prefers monthly billing but can accept net-30 on first invoice.
- Risk: procurement blackout weeks and legal turnaround times could push signature out ~2–3 weeks if not addressed now.

Proposed MAP (attached: MAP_blueport_v1.xlsx):
- Target close (contract signed): 2025-08-21
- Target go-live for pilot: 2025-09-08
- Key milestones and owners:
  * Kickoff + environment access — Owner: Karthik Iyer — due 2025-07-18
  * Security review / SOC evidence — Owner: Soojin Lee — due 2025-07-25
  * SOW redlines & signature — Owner: Blueport Legal (Tom) / Redwood Commercial — target signature by 2025-08-21
  * Procurement PO issuance — Owner: Blueport Procurement — target PO by 2025-08-14
  * Pilot readiness checklist — Owner: Marissa Cole — due 2025-08-28

Questions / asks:
1) Can procurement commit to PO issuance by 2025-08-14? If not, what blackout windows do we need to account for?
2) Karthik / Soojin — please confirm the milestone owners and any availability constraints this sprint.
3) Aisha — would a short 1-hour procurement alignment call next Tue (Jul 15) work to lock the PO timeline?

Next steps: I attached the MAP draft and a short SOW skeleton. If we can lock the PO date, I will push a revised MAP (v1.1) with tightened handoffs.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
[attachment: MAP_blueport_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@blueport.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@blueport.com>, Tom Evers <tevers@blueport.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft — owners, target close date, and procurement runway

Thanks Marissa — good summary and appreciate the clear asks. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement blackout: Finance has a scheduled systems maintenance week from 2025-08-18 through 2025-08-22 (billing and PO issuance will be limited). That makes the 2025-08-21 signature target risky.
- Legal availability: Tom is out Jul 22–Aug 1 for a conference; their usual turnaround is ~5 business days for simple SOWs, ~10 for redlines.
- PO cadence: we can often issue a PO early if commercial terms are approved, but we need the SOW doc final-ish to attach.

Options we can accept: move signature target up to 2025-08-14 (if Redwood can turn around commercial terms and SOW next week), or push to first week of September (post-maintenance). PM team prefers earlier if possible.

I can do the procurement alignment call Tue Jul 15 at 11:00 AM ET — confirm and I’ll block.

Aisha Malik
Procurement Lead | Blueport Systems
aisha.malik@blueport.com
[procurement@blueport.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@blueport.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Tom Evers <tevers@blueport.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 12:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft — owners, target close date, and procurement runway

Aisha — thanks for the heads-up. Given the maintenance window, I agree we should aim for an earlier signature if we can. Attached is a tightened MAP (MAP_blueport_v1.1.xlsx) with updated milestones and two alternate closing lanes:

Lane A (accelerated):
- Target signature: 2025-08-14
- Requirements: SOW redlines complete by 2025-07-18; commercial terms agreed by 2025-07-16; Redwood provides final SOW template today.

Lane B (fallback):
- Target signature: 2025-09-02
- Requirements: standard review windows post-maintenance.

Requests: 
- Karthik / Soojin: can you confirm you can deliver the security evidence pack and kickoff checklist by 2025-07-25 if we pursue Lane A?
- Aisha: I’ll send a tracked SOW version by EOD — can Blueport legal prioritize a 3–5 business day turnaround on redlines if we lock Lane A?

I’ll set the Tue Jul 15 procurement call for 11:00 AM ET unless I hear objections. Also adding a HubSpot link to the deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_blueport_v1.1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@blueport.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Tom Evers <tevers@blueport.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft — owners, target close date, and procurement runway

Thanks — quick operational notes from my side:
- I can take kickoff + environment access by 2025-07-18 but need the following from Blueport before then: a list of IP allowlists and a contact for infra access (secops).
- Security evidence pack: Soojin and I reviewed the checklist; we can produce the initial pack by 2025-07-25 but final SOC artifacts may need extra time. Recommend we mark the security milestone as "initial evidence" for Lane A and a follow-up closure milestone after pilot start.
- If Lane A is chosen, I propose we slot a 30-min technical handoff on 2025-07-20 to speed access.

I’ll join the Tue Jul 15 call at 11:00 AM ET. Marissa — please share the tracked SOW and I’ll add a short technical appendix to the SOW to clarify environment needs.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
[attachment: Blueport_SOW_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
